title: Hoped it would have more stability
text:
Hoped it would have more stability. I personally dont think its worth the money. Feels pretty unstable, was hoping to use it for my laptop but honestly i don't trust it. (Just my opinion)

Works great as a tv tray or light end table. Adjusting height is nice.

Just not ready to trust it with my laptop investment.

product_metadata.title: Table-Mate XL Plus TV Tray Table - Folding TV Dinner Table, Couch Table Trays for Eating Snack Food, Stowaway Laptop Stand, Portable Bed Dinner Tray - Adjustable TV Table with 4 Set Angles, Black
features: STURDY: These folding tray tables features a food-rated polypropylene top for meals or snacks, a drink holder that adjusts to any angle to prevent spills, and offers plenty of extra space for other items.
EASY TO ASSEMBLE: No tools needed to put this foldable tv dinner tray together. Just slide the steel legs together, insert the rods, and add the tray. To store, simply fold and pack away.
EXTRA LARGE: An extra 5'' depth and width easily replaces heavy, cumbersome desks and furniture
MULTIPURPOSE: Set the tv table tray to fit your needs. It can hold up to 40lbs and can be used as a TV dinner table, laptop desk, bedside tray, small folding table, couch table, and more.
THOUGHTFUL DESIGN: Pull these spacious food trays for eating on couch towards you and watch as the L-shaped legs seamlessly slide around the living room sofa or bed. No crossbar to get in the way!
